name: Dealer gamma (GEX) regime as an intraday filter or signal for US index CFD (incl. 0DTE SPX context)
source_url: https://www3.nd.edu/~zda/intramom.pdf (Baltussen, Da, Lammers, Martens, JFE 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.jfineco.2021.04.029); https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5641974 [uncertain: task brief pairs this SSRN id with the JFE paper, but the SSRN page is a 0DTE volatility study by Adams et al.]
author_year: Baltussen, Da, Lammers and Martens (2021), JFE 142(1):377-403 [uncertain: task brief lists 'Da-Lugt-Lammers'; search results show 'Lammers and Martens']. 0DTE study: Adams et al., SSRN 5641974, year not stated [uncertain]
instrument: US equity index futures/CFD (S&P 500 e-mini equivalent; Maven symbol mapping US500/US100 [uncertain]). Gamma input requires SPX/SPY option chain, which is not in Maven MT5 or Dukascopy
timeframe: Intraday: 30-minute windows (last 30 minutes before the 16:00 ET close). Cboe samples market-maker gamma in 30-minute increments
entry_rule: Baltussen et al. (2021): the return from prior close to about 15:30 ET predicts the last-30-minute return; the effect is significant when dealer negative gamma exposure (NGE proxy) is negative and stronger as NGE becomes more negative; no significant momentum on positive-NGE days (per secondary summary). No peer-reviewed tradable rule with exact thresholds was found. [uncertain] Any trading version must be pre-registered by the project
exit_rule: Not specified in the sources reviewed. Implied exit at 16:00 ET cash close [uncertain]
stop_rule: Not specified in the sources reviewed; no typical stop distance published [uncertain]
holding_time: About 30 minutes (last half hour before close) in the paper's design [uncertain for a tradable version]
trades_per_year: Up to about 250 if used every trading day; actual frequency depends on the NGE filter and is not reported [uncertain]
overnight_weekend: No overnight holding in the momentum design (flat at close). The paper reports reversal over the following days, so multi-day effects exist
signal_window_definition: Signal: return from prior close (or 09:30 ET open) to 15:30 ET. Trade window 15:30-16:00 ET. Gamma estimate must be known before 15:30 ET to avoid look-ahead. US DST and EU DST switch on different dates (about 2-3 weeks apart in March and October/November), so broker server time must be mapped to ET each day; the sources do not address this [uncertain]
sample_period: Baltussen et al.: intraday futures 1974-2020 (60+ markets); S&P 500 option-based NGE sample dates not confirmed [uncertain]. Adams et al. 0DTE study: pre-May 2022 Tuesday/Thursday expiry variation; exact dates not stated [uncertain]. FlashAlpha SPY daily study: 2018-04-16 to 2026-04-02 (vendor)
out_of_sample: No out-of-sample trading test found for the NGE-conditional intraday momentum. Adams et al.: no out-of-sample test mentioned. FlashAlpha daily SPY study (vendor, daily, not intraday): chronological 70/30 split with similar correlations in and out of sample. OptionMetrics (Maurer, May 2026) overnight-gap study: dealer gamma informative only in low-VIX regimes; out-of-sample element per secondary description
cost_assumption: Baltussen et al.: transaction-cost treatment not confirmed from accessible text [uncertain]. Adams et al.: says high-frequency hedging is profitable on average only when transaction costs are low; no figures. Concretum 0DTE article (paywalled): net-of-cost claim not verifiable
reported_metrics: Baltussen et al. abstract: momentum 'economically and statistically highly significant'; no coefficients accessible. Adams et al.: realized volatility about 60 annualized bps lower on 0DTE days; hedging needs +0.15 pp on 0DTE days; two-stage multiplier about -4; higher net gamma predicts lower 10-minute volatility, fading after about one hour. FlashAlpha SPY: raw GEX vs next-day RV Spearman -0.36 (n=1,971); Q5 minus Q1 next-day RV -10.63 vol points; after VIX and ATM IV controls, GEX -0.03 (p=0.18). Cboe (Sept 2023): median 3:30pm net gamma +173mm, but descriptive only. No trading Sharpe found for any GEX rule
third_party_replication: Not found for NGE-conditioned intraday momentum. FlashAlpha is a vendor study. Cboe (Sept 2023) is an exchange descriptive analysis, not a backtest; it finds no rise in 2-sigma one-minute gap frequency. The 0DTE volatility effect is reported to vanish once 0DTEs trade every business day from 2022
evidence_grade: Partly peer-reviewed (Baltussen et al., JFE 2021) for market intraday momentum; gamma-conditional part only partly verified. Plus working paper (Adams et al., SSRN), vendor backtests (FlashAlpha, Quantpedia-style summaries) and exchange commentary (Cboe). Overall: hakemli (partial) + calisma kagidi + pratisyen
decay_status: Unclear. Adams et al.: net gamma effect on volatility is short-lived (about one hour). Baltussen: momentum documented 1974-2020 but no post-2022 decay test for the NGE-conditional version found [uncertain]
regime_split: Adams et al.: 0DTE volatility effect identified on pre-May 2022 Tuesday/Thursday expiry variation and disappears after daily 0DTE expiries in 2022. Baltussen: momentum present when NGE is negative, not significant when positive (per secondary summary). FlashAlpha: GEX sign and VIX regime are correlated, so GEX may be a volatility-regime proxy
data_source_requirement: Requires historical option chains with open interest and Greeks (for NGE/GEX). Not in Maven MT5 or Dukascopy. Costs found: CBOE DataShop options intervals (history from Jan 2012, paid); Historicaloptiondata.com (SPX EOD with Greeks from 1990, price not found); QuantedOptions flagship listed at 399 USD/month; SqueezeMetrics GEX/DIX data plan listed at 720 USD/month with history since 2011 (secondary listing). Free: CBOE historical volume only (no gamma). A free SqueezeMetrics GEX CSV was mentioned by a secondary source but not confirmed on squeezemetrics.com [uncertain]. Free GEX history length not verified [uncertain]
min_lot_fit_5k10k: Not computable from sources: no stop distance is published and index contract size depends on the broker (Maven spec needed). [uncertain]
fn_rule_fit: Single intraday trade per day is not HFT, grid or tick-scalping. FN 3 percent open-risk rule and +-5 minute news 40 percent rule: the 15:30-16:00 ET window is usually free of scheduled US releases, but FOMC and other 14:00 ET events and month-end flows must be excluded [uncertain]. FN rule texts were taken from the task brief and not re-verified
bot_policy_compliance: Rule can run as an EA on a VPS, but it needs a live options-derived gamma feed at 15:30 ET, which means a paid API with its own terms. No messaging link required. Compliance with FN bot policy not verified [uncertain]
event_overlap: 15:30-16:00 ET: normally no scheduled US macro releases; overlaps with closing auction (MOC) imbalance flows near 15:50 ET and with monthly/quarterly opex hedging on expiry Fridays [uncertain: general market knowledge, not from sources]. Not relevant to the 16:00 ET close
overlap_with_existing: Possible overlap with the US100 Sweep module on late-session flows; not measured. Donchian XAU: low overlap (gold, different driver) [uncertain]
rejected_catalog_hit: Not checked against the elenenler catalog. Run `python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol gex` (and `--kontrol gamma`) in strategy-lab before pre-registration [uncertain]
base_rate_check: Intraday momentum into the close is a documented base effect, so the claim must beat the unconditional last-30-minute momentum rate. Share of NGE-negative days and conditional hit rate not reported in sources [uncertain]
pitfall_risk: High. (1) Look-ahead: close-of-day GEX used to label a 10:30 or 15:30 entry (warned by FlashAlpha and DEV sources); (2) post-hoc choice of NGE proxy and threshold; (3) overlapping daily windows counted as independent; (4) 0DTE evidence concentrated in pre-2022 Tue/Thu design; (5) spread and slippage on a 30-minute CFD trade; (6) gamma sign can flip in fast moves, as noted by commentary
priority_score: 2/5. Momentum base effect has peer-reviewed support, but the gamma-conditional trading edge is unproven, options data is paid and not in Maven, and the live-feed requirement fits 5K/10K accounts poorly
